- Imaging workup is specifically directed at subacromial structures (supraspinatus, bursa, calcifications)

[GAPS]  
- Left shoulder musculoskeletal ultrasound findings (pending; critical for confirming tendinosis, tear, bursitis, or calcification)  
- Physical exam findings (Neer/Hawkins, empty can test, strength, active/passive ROM — needed to support impingement or weakness patterns)  
- Duration of morning stiffness (to help exclude inflammatory arthropathy)  
- Global shoulder range of motion assessment (to detect capsular restriction vs. muscular inhibition)  
- Patient age, occupation, and handedness (contextual modifiers for likelihood and management)

[DIAGNOSIS]  
Subacromial pain syndrome
